label: University Korean language course: tuition per term
appliesTo: Regular Korean language courses at university-affiliated institutes
why: The number every budget starts from, and the one most often quoted as a single national figure when it is a range. Set by each university independently, so it drifts school by school rather than moving all at once.

history.source: Study in Korea — Korean language institute course information
history.note: The government portal indicates roughly ₩1,200,000 to ₩1,800,000 per term as the general level. Individual 2026 courses sit across that band — ₩1,750,000 at one Seoul university, ₩1,500,000 at another school. Value records the upper end of the stated range; always recalculate from the target university's current prospectus.
